fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Selenite and the Roots of Energy Work", "body": "Matt opened the show with a story about a child waving a selenite wand over his head, which he said convinced him that crystals were real. Chance replied that selenite had been the first thing to wake him to what his own internal energy felt like, and that he never attended an attunement before starting energy work. Chance said Qi Gong later refined that sense. Both men praised selenite as a light transmitter, and Matt said lasers pass through it without distortion."}, {"title": "Spero Protection Clothing and EMF Worries", "body": "Matt described his EMF protection clothing line, built around silver woven into fabric, and said he chose a rooster crest because the rooster symbolized casting away darkness. He recounted a failed search for copper fabric in Bangkok and said copper sheeting was dipped nylon that could not be washed. Matt argued that silver blocked only the narrow EMF band while sunlight still passed through. A chat member asked whether shielding blocked natural harmonics, and the talk turned to the idea that ancient kings wore metal headgear as protection."}, {"title": "Moon, Chemtrail and Drone Claims", "body": "Matt argued that the moon looked suspect, citing its apparent size, the dusk timing of full moons and his belief that moonlight was cold and encouraged decay. He said black chemtrails were coal fly ash that was dumped when filters were skipped, and he claimed the ash was shipped to Air Force bases for metal extraction. Answering a voice clip from Gabe, Matt said most of the planes involved were pilotless drones, while Chance relayed chat questions and the two traded code words for the vaccine."}, {"title": "Matt's Tucson Conference Story", "body": "Matt told his craziest activism story, saying he organized a chemtrail conference in Tucson to alert residents to a planned experiment to dim the sun with aluminum. He said the community said no and the experiment went on hiatus. He described a chaotic conference day, including a disruptive audience member and a police citation that was later dropped. Matt credited staying out of fear, which he called a frequency that could be controlled, and Chance argued the officers likely arrived expecting a confrontation."}, {"title": "Earth Pipes, Obstacles and Hope", "body": "Mitch joined from Sedona and said he had placed more than 2,000 orgonite earth pipes across Arizona, which he credited for a heavy monsoon season and a second spring. He said a road trip through several states showed more green than drought headlines suggested. Gordy left a voicemail saying owls and jaguars had returned. Asked about obstacles, Matt answered with trust in spirit, Mitch recalled the advice to wake the lions and not the sheep, and Chance shared an I Ching draw."}]
